column2: If the Seven of Amethysts comes up, I win from behind...{wait}{clear}
Go on... read it.{wait}{clear}
...It's the Seven of Amethysts.{wait}{clear}
Sorry, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
Tch...{wait}{clear}
Hey, this kind of thing happens all the time. No need to be down about it.{wait}{clear}
...Now, sorry to change the subject, but could you tell me where the Demon Stone hidden in the cathedral is?{wait}{clear}
A friend of mine can't find it, and he's in a bind.{wait}{clear}
...The altar of the east tower... beneath the spot where the bishop stands...{wait}{clear}
There's a hidden door there... the sealed chamber can be reached from it...{wait}{clear}
Oh, is that so? Thanks.{wait}{clear}
Just what I'd expect from His Holiness. You know it all.{n}{wait}{clear}
Well, let's call it a night.{wait}{clear}
If fate brings us together again, let's meet. I like you.{wait}{clear}
...Yes.{wait}{clear}
Oh, and pass a message on to the angel behind you.{wait}{clear}
Tell 'em that dumb look is cute.{wait}{clear}
See ya!{wait}{clear}
What's wrong? What happened?{wait}{clear}
...It's nothing... Don't worry about it.{wait}{clear}
Rocus...{wait}{clear}(But who in the world is he? Ordinary people shouldn't be able to see me, so why would he say that...?){wait}{clear}
Vice Pope
Sorry, but something's come up... Would you mind if we went back to the Holy City?{wait}{clear}
Not right now...{n}
Sorry...{wait}{clear}The Vice Pope apparently has something to discuss. It's a bother, but it can't be helped.{wait}{clear}
Did something happen?{n}
This Vice Pope...{n}
Nothing, nothing important...{wait}{clear}
He wants to tell me the details in person. That's what the messenger said.{wait}{clear}
Do you have any idea why?{n}
Is it about money again?{n}
Do you have any idea what it might be?{wait}{clear}
Who knows? There are too many possibilities to say.{wait}{clear}
Only...{wait}{clear}
Is something bothering you?{wait}{clear}
No... I'll find out when I see him...{wait}{clear}
Is it about money again?{wait}{clear}
Hmph, it might be. Well, if that's all it is, it's nothing new...{wait}{clear}
What sort of person is the Vice Pope?{wait}{clear}
He's led the Church in place of the absent Pope for a very long time now.{wait}{clear}The cleric of clerics, I suppose...{wait}{clear}
Well, every time I see him, I get a sermon.{wait}{clear}This time will be no different...{wait}{clear}
Something may happen. Couldn't you ask him to make it another time?{wait}{clear}
Sorry, but I can't refuse a summons from the Vice Pope.{wait}{clear}It's a bother for me too...{wait}{clear}
